svg.title: S.C.O.U.T. system block diagram (draft 2026-10-14)
svg.text: DRAFT v0.2, 2026-10-14 · battery-only printed-float buoy · dashed orange = undecided, red dashed = conflict between sources (see box, bottom right)
2 Electronics housing (4.4 in ID × 5 in), O-ring face seal + tape
3 Printed float: sealed chambers, 1154 g, no foam
5 Mooring line to anchor or tether; ballast TBD
Rev A bench: PID 6106 + LiPo → 5 V
D8 CS · D4 RST · D3 INT
SENSOR POD + EXTERNAL (flooded, below the float)
in the pod, 5 V sensor, analog
dashboard viewers · team · advisors · NOAA contact
Conflicts and gaps to fix on the next pass
1 Power: 2× lithium D cells decided (solar dropped 2026-10-07). Rev A bench is LiPo +
PID 6106. ADR-0002 not yet superseded; D-cell regulation undefined.
2 Sensor gate polarity: firmware HIGH = on, SCO-186 wants P-FET LOW = on.
3 Temp pin D5 on the schematic vs D12 in firmware; RTC wake INT has no wire.
4 Shore compute: Feather S3 + LoRa module vs Raspberry Pi.
5 Hydrophone part number (SCO-8); audio path A3 not defined.
6 Pod attachment to the float and ballast material undecided.
7 Leak sensor and SMA bulkhead not yet built.
8 Anchored vs tethered mooring depends on permits (SCO-185).
buoy-stability printed-float STEP. Voltages and pins
marked TBD are not settled. Owner: John (SCO-187).
